newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end with solid gains, tracking Dow rally.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end with solid gains, tracking Dow rally.

text.p: Britain's leading shares ended with solid gains on Tuesday as benign U.S. inflation data sparked a sharp rally on Wall Street and restored investors' confidence, dealers and strategists said.
The benchmark FTSE 100 index closed 35.1 points higher at 4,286.8, as advancers broadly outpaced decliners 78 to 16.
The Dow, propelled by a smaller-than-expected 0.1 percent increase in March consumer prices, was up about 83 points when London markets closed, on top of Monday's 60-point rebound.
